Before Keiran's elite unit, the Ebon Falcons, was sent to war-torn Kryta to aid the Shining Blade, he and Gwen quarreled, and Keiran marched to war questioning his role in her life. The Ebon Vanguard believed that he perished in that savage war, but Keiran Thackeray is a hard man to kill...}} [[Keiran Thackeray|Lieutenant Keiran Thackeray]] is an officer of the Ebon Vanguard and leader of the [[Ebon Falcons]], and grew up around [[Drascir]]. He made his first appearance during the [[Wintersday 2008|Wintersday 1078]] [[Mouvelian calendar|AE]] celebrations, when he was left in charge of the [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]]. During his time in charge, he went to great lengths (or more accurately, enlisted the help of hapless players to go to great lengths for him) to cheer up a lonely [[Gwen]]. In the time since then, a romance has developed between the two of them, however for a time this was on hold after Gwen's refusal to celebrate her own birthday led to a falling-out between the pair. He was then dispatched, along with [[Captain Langmar]] and the rest of his unit, to [[Kryta]] to help the [[Shining Blade]] in their civil war in exchange for Krytan aid against the [[Charr]], with words left unsaid between him and Gwen. Although his role was mainly limited to training new recruits, during [[the Battle for Lion's Arch]], he bought [[Ascalon]] settlers time to escape to the relative safety of the capital by helping to divert [[White Mantle]] forces, along with Captain Langmar and [[Captain Greywind]]. He did not return after the battle, and was listed as missing in action. A devastated Gwen, now in command of the Ebon Vanguard, used [[Keiran's Bow|one of his bows]] and the [[Scrying Pool]] to locate him, witnessing the events that followed the battle. Traveling through Kryta, a bedraggled Thackeray encountered [[Miku]], with whom he hunted down and killed [[Danthor the Adamant]]. The two then pursued the remaining White Mantle forces to their base in the [[Maguuma Jungle]], where they discovered a plan to massacre [[Beetletun]] and place the blame on the Shining Blade. They returned to the town and Thackeray used his newfound [[leadership]] skills to rally townspeople to fight the Mantle, and together they successfully repelled the attack. With his potential as a Paragon now realized, Miku invited him to join her on her return to [[Cantha]], but Thackeray declined, instead opting to return to the Vanguard. Eventually, he made his way to the [[Shiverpeak Mountains|Shiverpeaks]], and at [[Anvil Rock]] he was reunited with Gwen.
